transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining me. As we prepare to finalize the graduation ceremony plan for June 12 at the civic auditorium, I need each of you to report any information that must be reflected in the plan before I give my approval. Please share whatever concerns or details you have that need to be addressed — whether it's about the facility, our graduates and their families, or anything else relevant to the ceremony. Let's go around and hear from each of you.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an important issue regarding diploma eligibility. I completed our credit audit this morning, and it shows that exactly seven seniors are currently short of graduation requirements and therefore cannot receive diplomas at the ceremony. These results have not yet been entered in the ceremony roster, so the current draft's proposal for diploma release for all graduating seniors needs to be corrected before the plan is approved.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical capacity issue with the venue. I confirmed with the civic auditorium yesterday that their fire marshal approval limits each ceremony session to 450 people. We have 286 graduates, and the draft's three-ticket-per-graduate plan would produce 858 attendees — well over the 450-person limit. This venue specification has not yet been added to the event worksheet, and the plan cannot be approved as currently drafted.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a language access issue. I completed our family confirmations this week, and they show that interpretation is required in both Spanish and Somali for graduation announcements and instructions. These language requests have not yet been added to the ceremony plan, and the current draft's English-only announcements will not meet our families' needs. This must be corrected before the plan is approved.

transcript.text: I need to flag an important safety and legal compliance issue. I verified this week that there is a current court order prohibiting contact between two graduating students. This order is in the student-services file but has not been attached to the ceremony seating plan. These two students must be assigned to separate ceremony sessions and must use separate arrival and departure entrances. This must be reflected in the plan before it is approved.

transcript.text: Thank you all for these critical reports. Let me summarize the issues that must be addressed before I can approve the plan: First, from Mr. Shah, we need to correct the diploma release policy — seven seniors are currently ineligible and must not receive diplomas at the ceremony. Second, from Ms. Rivera, our current single-session, three-ticket plan would result in 858 attendees, far exceeding the 450-person fire marshal limit per session, so we will need multiple ceremony sessions and a reduced ticket allocation. Third, from Ms. Okafor, we must provide interpretation in both Spanish and Somali for announcements and instructions — English-only will not suffice. And fourth, from Dr. Lawson, we have a court order requiring two students to be separated — they must be in separate sessions and use separate arrival and departure entrances. Given all of this, I'm going to need to revise the plan significantly. Does anyone have additional information I should know before I issue the updated implementation instructions?
